hadith:
One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus) - Narrated Anas:

The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I give to Quraish people in order to let them adhere to Islam, for they are near to their life of Ignorance (i.e. they have newly embraced Islam and it is still not strong in their hearts."
message: Reflect upon the fact that every action is witnessed by Allah, as He is Ash Shaheed, the All-Witnessing. This awareness should inspire us to live righteously and avoid deceitful plots against others. Remember, true success lies in adhering to faith and striving for good deeds, which ultimately benefit both individuals and society.
name:
Ash Shaheed - الشَّهِيدُ - The Witness

The name Ash Shaheed represents God's omnipresence and omniscience, emphasizing that nothing escapes His knowledge. The origin of this name is rooted in Arabic, with 'Shaheed' deriving from the verb 'shahada', meaning to witness. It is a reminder for believers to act with integrity and righteousness, understanding that their actions are observed and recorded.
verse:
At-Tur - The Mount - 52:41-42

Or do they have access to ˹the Record in˺ the unseen, so they copy it ˹for all to see˺?

Or do they intend to scheme ˹against the Prophet˺? Then it is the disbelievers who will fall victim to ˹their˺ schemes.
